verdict.rationale: Glama publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document for its MCP directory API at /api/mcp/openapi.json. It is advertised from llms.txt "for generating a client" and discoverable through an RFC 9727 API catalog whose service-desc links to the spec. The spec also carries machine-readable deprecation flags. The probe 404s were at different guessed paths, so they do not contradict the published spec location. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of downloading and using the spec, and spec coverage for the Gateway (an MCP proxy with no separate REST spec).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
